question.prompt: Quadrilateral \(ABCD\) is inscribed in circle \(\odot O\). Point \(A\) lies on the major arc \(BD\), and \(\angle BOD=140^\circ\). Find \(\angle C\) (in degrees).

solutions.explanation: \(\angle A=\angle BOD\div 2=70^\circ\). Opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral are supplementary, so \(\angle C=180^\circ-70^\circ=110^\circ\).
solutions.title: Find A and use opposite angles

solutions.explanation:
The opposite vertices \(A\) and \(C\) lie on opposite arcs with endpoints \(B,D\). Since \(A\) lies on the major arc \(BD\), \(C\) lies on the minor arc, so \(\angle C\) intercepts the major arc. This arc measures \(360^\circ-140^\circ=220^\circ\). By the inscribed angle theorem,
\[
\angle C=\frac{220^\circ}{2}=110^\circ.
\]
solutions.title: Use the major arc directly
